fnol_text: My name is Maya Oyelaran and I live at 171 Alder Street, Salem, MA 01957. You can reach me on (555) 584-6612 or maya.oyelaran@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 22 April 2024. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00082. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Oyelaran on (555) 584-6612 to acknowledge the claim. Maya confirmed the loss date as 22 April 2024.
Site visit to 171 Alder Street. Neighbour Owen Rasmussen was present and confirmed the timeline.
Maya sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
